all_variants.description: true returns every offer variant (each quality per provider); false the best one per provider and monetization type.

countries.description: Countries to return offers for; default the URL's country or US.

imdb_id.description: With `query`: the search result whose IMDb id matches is used. JustWatch has no direct lookup by IMDb id. Pattern: ^tt[0-9]{5,10}$.

language.description:
ISO 639-1 language for titles, descriptions and genre names (en, de, fr, ...). Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

Provider reference: default "en".

monetization_types.description: Keep only these offer types; default all.

query.description: Title text used to locate the title when `imdb_id` or `tmdb_id` is given.

title_id.description: JustWatch node id: tm<n> movie, ts<n> show, tss<n> season, tse<n> episode. Returned as `id` by every function. Pattern: ^(tm|ts|tss|tse)[0-9]{1,12}$.

tmdb_id.description: With `query`: the search result whose TMDB id matches is used. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,10}$.

url.description: A justwatch.com title page URL (https://www.justwatch.com/us/movie/inception, /de/Film/Inception, /us/tv-show/slow-horses/season-1) or its site-relative path. The country prefix selects the default country.
